role: Gate: replays ExplosionProbe's 3000 explosions over a scattered region (shapes.bin) through expl_run: chooser draws, affected positions in HashSet order, block writes, drops, entity state after, region hash and RNG states per case. --cases N (make smoke): the first N cases, without the end Det compare.
notes: Data: out/java/explosions/*. Carries its own small JSON parser (jv_*). Prints destroyed, fire, drop, damaged and affected counts. Test code, built only into out/native/test_*; not on the product or GPU path, so no GPU hazards are listed.
